newsitem.title: USA: J.P. Morgan EMBI+ index up 2.3 percent in June.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Morgan EMBI+ index up 2.3 percent in June.

text.p: J.P. Morgan's Emerging Markets Bond Index Plus (EMBI+) rose 2.3 percent in June, bringing its year-to-date return to 10.27 percent, J.P. Morgan said.
"Continuing improvements in economic fundamentals in most emerging market countries and expectations of further credit rating increases boosted returns in June," the report said.
Bulgaria turned in the month's best performance, rising 7.27 percent. Russia rose 4.58 percent.
In addition, the Emerging Local Markets Index (ELMI) rose 1.2 percent in June and 5.03 percent so far in 1997.
Thailand registered the greatest return, at 5.2 percent. Poland lagged other ELMI countries with its 1.21 percent decline.
